about_short_description.short_description: WheeKeep provides portable storage solutions to keep belongings safe.

product.name: Portable Storage Units
product.description: Portable storage containers delivered to customers for packing and storing belongings, which can be kept onsite or transported to a secure facility.

product.name: On-Site Storage Units
product.description: Storage units delivered and kept at the customer's location for temporary or long-term storage, accessible and secured by the customer.

product.name: Moving Storage Units
product.description: Portable storage units delivered to customers for packing, then transported to a new location or stored at a secure facility until needed.

product.name: Automated Commercial Self-Storage
product.description: An unmanned, automated self-service storage solution for commercial clients to store goods offsite with flexible access and billing.

product.name: Business Storage Solutions
product.description: Customized portable storage services for businesses to store equipment, inventory, records, and supplies securely with flexible delivery and storage options.

product.name: Packing Services
product.description: Professional packing assistance using specialized materials to prepare goods for long-term storage within WheeKeep units.
